READING THE NUMBERS

Clear scope, honest timestamps.

This terminal shows simulated account equity, cash, paper positions, and ledger-reported performance. A return or risk statistic appears only when its sample and accounting coverage are sufficient; a blank value is not zero.

QQQ and SPY comparisons require aligned, distribution-aware benchmark history. No relative-return number is inferred from a raw market quote or an incomplete book record.

US-listed ETF shares and native crypto spot markets have different sessions, instruments, and settlement structures. They remain separate in the display.
